req.title: Player payload includes firstName and lastName
req.statement: The system shall include firstName and lastName fields on every player response.
triggers: player payload includes firstname and lastname

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that every player response must include 'firstName' and 'lastName'. We will test this by verifying the presence of these fields in a successful response, handling a negative case where the player does not exist, and testing a boundary case with the first player in the dataset.

tests.name: test_player_response_includes_first_and_last_name
preconditions: Player with ID '5a9cd988-95e6-54c1-bc34-9aa08acca8d0' exists in the database.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app
client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/players/5a9cd988-95e6-54c1-bc34-9aa08acca8d0')
assert response.status_code == 200
json_data = response.json()
assert 'firstName' in json_data
assert 'lastName' in json_data

tests.name: test_player_not_found
preconditions: Player with ID '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' does not exist in the database.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app
client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/players/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
assert response.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_boundary_case_first_player
preconditions: Player with ID '5a9cd988-95e6-54c1-bc34-9aa08acca8d0' is the first player in the database.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app
client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/players/5a9cd988-95e6-54c1-bc34-9aa08acca8d0')
assert response.status_code == 200
json_data = response.json()
assert 'firstName' in json_data
assert 'lastName' in json_data
